description:
Complete a partially-drawn Causal Loop Diagram (CLD) for urban traffic congestion in draw.io. 

1. Open the file '~/Diagrams/traffic_congestion_cld.drawio' which contains 6 initial variables.
2. Read the full model specification in '~/Desktop/cld_requirements.txt'.
3. Add the 8 missing variables specified in the requirements (e.g., Air Quality, Fuel Consumption, etc.).
4. Add causal links (arrows) between variables as specified, and label EVERY arrow with its polarity ('+' or '-').
5. Identify and annotate the 5 feedback loops (R1, R2, B1, B2, B3) with text labels indicating the loop identifier and type (Reinforcing/Balancing).
6. Add a legend explaining the notation.
7. Export the final diagram as a PDF to '~/Diagrams/traffic_congestion_cld.pdf'.

Note: This is a Systems Thinking task. Follow standard CLD notation: '+' means variables move in the same direction, '-' means opposite direction.
